description: This Java class 'ReadableProductReview' extends 'ProductReviewEntity' and represents a product review with an associated customer object. It implements Serializable and provides getter and setter for the customer.

classes.name: ReadableProductReview
classes.description: A Java class representing a readable product review, including customer information.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with this review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with this review.
